subject: Coord: CloudBridge marketplace demo + technical deep-dive — scheduling
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit@acme-inc.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + next steps: Redwood x CloudBridge (Acme)

Thanks again for the intro call this morning — great discussion all. Quick recap and a proposed next step so we keep momentum: 

- Acme is evaluating marketplace distribution and wants a hosted inference path with predictable latency for customer-facing features (primarily text-generation + embeddings).
- We agreed it makes sense to run a joint partner-led session where CloudBridge introduces the marketplace onboarding and Redwood covers a short technical deep-dive + live demo focused on latency profiles and deployment options.

Would the following windows work for a 60–75 minute joint meeting (partner + Acme + Redwood eng/SEs):
- Wed 11 Mar: 10:00–11:15 PT
- Thu 12 Mar: 13:00–14:15 PT

Attached is a lightweight "Marketplace Onboarding Checklist" that lists items we typically cover (SSO, billing flow, API keys, playbook). Can you confirm availability and who will send the invite?

Elena
Elena Rossi
Partnerships, CloudBridge
elena@cloudbridge.com

Attachments: Marketplace_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (stapled)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@cloudbridge.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit@acme-inc.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + next steps: Redwood x CloudBridge (Acme)

Thanks, Elena — solid recap. I can take point on the Redwood agenda for the demo/deep-dive. Proposed plan:

1) 15m partner intro (CloudBridge) — marketplace model + how customers appear
2) 30–35m Redwood technical deep-dive + live demo (latency comparatives, batching, and quantization notes)
3) 15–20m Q&A + ops checklist (SSO, billing, sandbox access)

Both windows work for me; my preference is Wed 11 Mar 10:00 PT. Vivek / Rishi — can one of you confirm availability and whether you want to present any of the infra/ops pieces?

I will also attach the Acme requirements doc we collected during discovery to the invite once we lock time.

Thanks — will wait for confirmation and then I'll send a calendar invite with the agenda + links.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachments: Acme_Requirements_v1.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Elena Rossi <elena@cloudbridge.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit@acme-inc.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + next steps: Redwood x CloudBridge (Acme)

All — Wed 11 Mar 10:00 PT works for me. I'll cover the deployment/ops portion (brief: VPC vs hosted, KV cache considerations, quantization tradeoffs) and can bring the engineer who owns our marketplace integration if helpful.

A few asks before the session so we can tailor the demo:
- Amit / Acme: can you share expected peak RPS and 95th percentile latency targets for your customer-facing feature? Even ballpark is fine.
- Any constraints around data residency or SSO (SAML/SCIM)?
- If you can share a representative prompt/embedding use-case, we'll prepare a short benchmark during the demo.

Marissa — go ahead and send the invite and include a Google Drive link (or Box) for the attachments so folks can review pre-read. I'll add a short slide deck for the ops section.

Thanks,
Vivek
Director, Partnerships (Marketplace Integrations)
Redwood Inference

From: Amit Shah <amit@acme-inc.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@cloudbridge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2026 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + next steps: Redwood x CloudBridge (Acme)

Thanks, everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. Wed 11 Mar 10:00 PT is good for our team as well.

Quick answers to Vivek's asks:
- Peak RPS: ~40 concurrent requests during peak usage (customer-facing chat).
- 95th pct latency target: sub-400ms for short responses (under 200 tokens).
- No special residency requirements; SSO via SAML would be ideal.
- Representative prompt: "Customer support summarization + suggested KB articles" (we can share a sanitized example in Drive).

Please send the calendar invite and include the Drive link for the pre-read and the onboarding checklist. Who will own the invite?

Amit Shah
Lead Product Manager, Acme Inc.
amit@acme-inc.com
